strengths: The neon synthwave palette holds together: a dark grid in magenta and blue, glowing pink edges, bright corner posts with bloom, and a starfield behind a dark planet silhouette
Eating feedback is clear and lasts: a gold shockwave ring, sparkle particles and a bright flash on the head, still visible at 450 ms
The HUD is clean and matches the theme (score, best, level). Title and game-over panels are styled consistently, and game over shows a 'NEW BEST' badge
Motion is smooth: the head is between cells in the 160 ms frames. All 13/13 browser checks pass, there are 0 page errors, and the autopilot ate 22 foods in 40 s
The food is a glowing gem with a ring under it, which makes the target easy to read
weaknesses: The snake is only a short chain of small spheres and looks tiny against a large board. Near the far wall it gets hard to read
The camera is a fixed, distant high-angle view. The play area fills the screen but the snake gets few pixels, and no shadows show under the snake or the food
Most of the board is empty and repeats the same pattern. Outside the board edges the scene has little 3D detail or modeled geometry
On the phone in portrait the board is small and rotated, with large empty areas above and below it
Level still shows 1 at a score of 20, so the pictures show no level progression
oneLine: A coherent, polished neon build with good eating effects and stable play, held back by a tiny snake made of plain spheres and a distant fixed camera that make it read as competent rather than striking.
